text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock E for gains felt rewarding, but a realized gain alone is not a reason to sell; use consistent portfolio goals and risk limits.","I made no trades after Period 4 despite later account fluctuations. Since past price moves do not predict future ones, I should keep reviewing periodically but trade only when my plan or circumstances warrant it.","My reluctance to admit a losing purchase could keep me holding too long. I should reassess each position objectively and accept a loss when the investment case or my risk limits call for it."]}
